symptom: Authoring a pluggable widget with an **object list** (Accordion group, Pop-up menu item, chart series) raises **CE0463** "the definition of this widget has changed" on the widget itself, on a widget created seconds ago against the current package
cause: An object-list item's **required TextTemplate** that the author left unset was serialized as `null`. `emptyClientTemplateRules` in `widgetobj/builder.go` is a hardcoded per-widget table covering only DataGrid columns, so every other object-list widget fell through it. Required-ness is genuinely absent from the widget XML for these properties — and the widget schema **defaults `required` to true** — so the Accordion's `headerText` is mandatory even though nothing says so
insight: Serialize a required unset TextTemplate with the widget's **shipped `<translations>`**, read off the template ValueType's `Translations` beside the `Required` flag. **Both weaker forms were measured and fail**: `null` is CE0463, and an *empty* `Forms$ClientTemplate` is **CE4899** "Property 'Groups/1/Text' is required" — so the intuitive "emit an empty template" fix only moves the error. Populating is what `mx update-widgets` itself writes (verified: mxcli and the reference now emit the same `'Header'`/`'Koptekst'`). Scope it to **required** properties: filling every TextTemplate is the documented way to take CE0463 from 33 to 127. Note `PropertyTypeIDEntry` exists in THREE places (`mdl/types` — canonical and aliased by `modelsdk/widgets`; `sdk/pages` — what the builder consumes; `sdk/widgets` — the legacy engine's own), so a field added for this must be carried through `convertPropTypeIDs` or it silently never arrives. Repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/891-accordion-group-nested-widgets.mdl`. Issue #891
